quotes.quote: DESeq2 (v1.26.0) [ 14 ] was applied for the detection of differentially expressed genes (DEGs) and other non-coding RNAs between tumor and non-tumor samples with a P -value of ≤0.05 and fold change (FC) of ≥2.
RNAseq (mRNA, lncRNA, circRNA, and miRNA) data are available at GEO under accession number GSE165298 .

G1.rationale: The principal differential expression results are produced by DESeq2 on RNA-seq data deposited at GEO, so a third party can re-run the computation.

quotes.quote: A total of 1,962 genes were differentially expressed between LAUD and non-tumor samples, 809 of which were upregulated and 1,153 were downregulated ( Figure 2B ).

G2.rationale: The first principal quantitative result reported is the number of differentially expressed genes, with exact counts.

quotes.quote: RNAseq (mRNA, lncRNA, circRNA, and miRNA) data are available at GEO under accession number GSE165298 .
After removing adapters, clean reads were aligned to the human reference genome (hg38) to quantify coding genes, lncRNAs, and circRNAs.

G3.rationale: The GEO deposit contains raw count and FPKM files for mRNA, lncRNA, circRNA, and miRNA, which are the analysis inputs for differential expression.
